newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates ease to 20.125 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates ease to 20.125 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates eased to close at 20.125 percent on Monday, from Friday's close of 20.375, traders said.
"Activity was average this morning," said Balazs Varga of Inter-Europa Bank.
He added that overnight rates were likely to hover around 20.00 percent on Tuesday.
In the absence of any market-moving factors, Hungarian overnight rates usually hover around the central bank's benchmark one-week reverse repo facility, currently standing at 20.00 percent.
